title: Digital GPIO input and output

spans.text: LESSON PURPOSE

Goal: apply “Digital GPIO input and output” to a real program or device. The key principle is: INPUT_PULLUP enables an internal pull-up for the idle input. In a project, follow this guidance: Give a button input a defined idle level to reduce false transitions.
QUESTION: What will this example do? Predict the result first.
EXAMPLE CODE
EXPECTED RESULT
No output; with INPUT_PULLUP, pressed is true when the input reads LOW.
CORE EXPLANATION
pinMode configures direction; digitalRead and digitalWrite handle logic levels. Inputs must not float: use a suitable pull-up/down and account for button bounce.
IMPORTANT LINE BREAKDOWN
Key line:
bool pressed = digitalRead(buttonPin) == LOW;

What it does: INPUT_PULLUP enables an internal pull-up for the idle input.
Why it is used: Give a button input a defined idle level to reduce false transitions.
If omitted or changed: Logic levels and GPIO limits are board-specific; never exceed pin current ratings.
